brief:
U.S. Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib called on the Biden administration to halt what she described as American complicity in ongoing Israeli crimes against Palestinians in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Tlaib made the statement in a post on X, the social media platform formerly known as Twitter.

The Michigan Democrat has been a vocal critic of U.S. military aid to Israel and American support for Israeli operations in Gaza since the October 2023 escalation of the conflict.

title: Tlaib calls on US to end complicity in Gaza crimes
